title: Rainier Flight Service
specs: Custom syllabi with real-world flying missions and simulator integration
Private Pilot Certificate required for Instrument Rating course
Be at least 16 years old to solo and 17 to obtain Private Pilot License
Hold at least a third-class medical certificate or BasicMed for Private Pilot course
Flight instructor certificate required for Instrument Instructor course
Commercial Pilot Certificate with Multi-Engine Class Rating and Flight Instructor Certificate required for Multi Engine Instructor course
includes: Flight training, preflight and postflight briefings
Use of FAA-approved Advanced Aviation Training Device (AATD) for instrument instructor course
gap: Exact age minimums for all courses except Private Pilot not stated
blurb: Rainier Flight Service offers comprehensive flight training courses designed to prepare students for various pilot certifications. Courses include practical flight training, simulator sessions, and ground school, with a focus on real-world flying skills and decision-making. Training is structured in stages with proficiency assessments at each stage.
extraNote: Cancel within 24 hours of scheduled time may incur half aircraft rental fee or full instructor rate · No-show may be billed half aircraft rental fee plus instructor time · Refunds for prepaid deposits generally refundable; aircraft rentals generally non-refundable · Ground school refunds if cancelled at least 48 hours prior to first class · Gift certificates and discovery flight credits non-refundable and not redeemable for cash
